approvalScope.description: Approval with conditions for WEOS-OD-022 Stage 1 repository-native Runtime Role to Authority Assignment contracts, schemas, pure in-memory authority-type registry, validation, scope evaluation, delegation, grant non-escalation, separation-of-duties, authority resolution, conformance tests and documentation integration.

approverAuthority: Founding Architecture Authority bootstrap authority for initial WEOS governance foundation only
rationale: WEOS requires a strict separation between technical runtime access and scoped canonical authority before governed runtime command enforcement can be designed safely. This record approves WEOS-OD-022 with conditions for Stage 1 repository-native contracts only, using WEOS-AUTH-APP-002 as dependency evidence for compatibility with the Governance Decision Envelope.
conditions: runtime roles, execution identity and canonical authority must remain separate; runtime roles are technical-access evidence only
authority-bearing governed actions require independently validated, scoped AuthorityAssignments
authority types are governed powers independent of runtime role labels such as USER, EDITOR, SENIOR_EDITOR and ADMIN
validation and resolution must fail closed when authority is absent, unknown, expired, revoked, suspended, superseded, invalid, unregistered or out of scope

global authority requires explicit GLOBAL scope mode, approved authority-type policy permission, rationale, enhanced evidence, authorized grantor, expiry or review and explicit marking; empty scope is never global
authority evidence, granting snapshot, grantor identity, validity windows and review metadata must be preserved at grant time and compatible with WEOS-OD-018 decision evidence fields
grant authority is distinct from action authority and requires AUTHORITY_ASSIGNMENT_GRANT
grant and delegation validation must prevent escalation of authority type, scope, duration, delegation rights or depth
delegation is denied by default and must reject missing permission, circular delegation, self-parenting, self-originating grants and escalation
separation-of-duties checks must be policy-driven rather than hardcoded as a single domain rule
non-human execution by SERVICE_ACCOUNT, AUTOMATION or SYSTEM is not human or institutional authority by itself
ordinary assignments do not establish emergency or break-glass authority
role, profile, frontend visibility, dashboard access, repository ownership, employment title, previous action or mutable status backfill is prohibited
bootstrap authority is not converted into production AuthorityAssignments
no production assignments, persistence, Prisma, migrations, runtime enforcement, guards, controllers, command handlers, dashboards or deployment are authorized

bootstrapAuthority.scope: Initial WEOS governance foundation for repository-native authority-assignment contracts, JSON schemas, TypeScript serializable contracts, pure in-memory authority-type registry, validation, actor-command-context validation, authority resolution, scope evaluation, grant non-escalation, delegation, separation-of-duties, deterministic conformance tests and documentation integration only. This does not grant real assignments, institutional authority, Prisma, persistence, API, runtime service, guard, controller, command-handler, dashboard, break-glass, backfill, deployment or production enforcement authority.
bootstrapAuthority.expiryCondition: Expires when a permanent authority-assignment process approved under WEOS-OD-022 or an approved successor becomes effective.
